s: to what degree, to what extent
Ich weiß nicht, inwieweit sich das auf unsere Arbeit auswirkt.
I don't know to what extent it will affect our work.
To what degree are we responsible for this?
inhabitant of a city without the full rights of a citizen
Inwohner.et: From Middle High German inwoner, innewoner. Equivalent to in- + wohnen + -er. See Einwohner for more.

s: in reality, in truth, in fact, truth be told, actually, really
